listingUrls.title: Listing URLs
listingUrls.description: Zillow or Redfin property detail URLs. Strings or objects containing url and optional address. Provide both providers with the same address to enable direct fallback.

addresses.title: Addresses (optional)
addresses.description: Full US addresses: street, city, state ZIP. URLs are faster; address-only input starts a separately billed Google Search Actor.

enabledSources.title: Enabled sources
enabledSources.description: Providers to try. Include both to allow Zillow/Redfin fallback for an address.

downloadImages.title: Save image files
downloadImages.description: Save photos in the default key-value store. Image URLs are returned even when downloads fail.

maxImagesPerListing.title: Maximum images per listing
maxImagesPerListing.description: Maximum photo records returned per property. Set 200 to collect larger galleries.

useBrowserFallback.title: Use browser fallback
useBrowserFallback.description: Render the public listing when HTML has no usable verified gallery. Known 403/429 blocks are not retried.

allowAddressSearch.title: Allow address search
allowAddressSearch.description: Start apify/google-search-scraper only when no usable supplied listing remains. Additional Actor charges may apply.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify or custom proxy settings. Residential access depends on your Apify account.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrent properties
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum properties processed concurrently. Default 1 limits request bursts.

minDomainDelaySecs.title: Minimum gap between listing requests per host
minDomainDelaySecs.description: Minimum gap between listing navigations to the same hostname; browser subresources are separate.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum duration of an individual listing or image request.

perListingTimeoutSecs.title: Budget per property (seconds)
perListingTimeoutSecs.description: Total time for one property, including optional discovery and image downloads.

searchTimeoutSecs.title: Maximum discovery time (seconds)
searchTimeoutSecs.description: Discovery ceiling, further limited to a quarter of the remaining work budget.

maxRunSecs.title: Run work budget (seconds)
maxRunSecs.description: Overall work budget. Set the platform run timeout at least 15 seconds higher.

maxImageMbytes.title: Maximum size per image (MB)
maxImageMbytes.description: Reject any single downloaded image larger than this limit.
